Diamond Springs Ranch • Sedgwick, Kansas

Learn to ride the right way.

Private and group riding lessons for all ages. We use Clinton Anderson's Down Under Horsemanship method — safe, proven, and built on partnership.

Book a Lesson Ask a Question
Scroll

The people who teach lessons here are the same ones who feed and work these horses every morning. They’re not certified instructors hired to fill a weekend program — they’re the people who actually know these animals. That’s the foundation of everything we teach. Real horsemanship. Real horses. Real instruction.

We use Clinton Anderson’s Down Under Horsemanship method. It’s safe, it’s proven, and it’s built on building an actual partnership between horse and rider — not just teaching someone where to sit. If you’ve never been around horses before, this is where to start. If you’ve ridden before and want to actually understand what you’re doing, this is also where to start.

Riding Lesson Pricing and Packages

Lessons start at $50/hour. We work with families and individuals who want to build a consistent schedule — call (316) 303-6195 to talk through packages and what makes sense for your situation. All lessons are by reservation only.

What Ages Can Take Riding Lessons at Diamond Springs Ranch?

Starting at 5 years old. Young kids, teenagers, adults, seniors — all welcome. We match the instruction to the student, not the other way around. If you rode as a kid and fell off the horse (literally or figuratively) years ago and want to come back to it, we can work with that too.

What Do Riding Lessons Cover?

Beginners start with the foundation: safe mounting and dismounting, seat and position, steering and stopping, and how to read what the horse is telling you. Intermediate students build from there. Every lesson includes horsemanship — because a rider who understands horses is always going to be safer, more confident, and more effective than one who doesn’t. This isn’t follow-the-leader. It’s real equine education on a real working ranch.

Book Riding Lessons Near Wichita

Diamond Springs Ranch is 15 minutes north of Wichita — 2 miles off I-135. If you’ve been looking for riding lessons in the Wichita metro and wanted something grounded in real ranch horsemanship, this is it. Call or text (316) 303-6195 to get scheduled.
